radical_exp_strategy.configuration.title: Radical Exp Strategy Configs
radical_exp_strategy.configuration.exper: How many ticks the player must wait before picking up another experience orb. Default: 2 (vanilla).
radical_exp_strategy.configuration.direc: When enabled, experience orbs from player kills (mobs) are directly added to the player's XP bar without spawning an orb entity.
radical_exp_strategy.configuration.aggre: When enabled, all experience orbs can merge regardless of value. Merged orbs accumulate total XP for one-big-pickup.
radical_exp_strategy.configuration.maxXp: Maximum experience value a single orb fragment can hold. Vanilla: 2477.
